answer: The delta cap is enforced at intake and spiral shows the per-origin counts. At most 5 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a cipher tag. A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a fleet in one epoch whatever the capital it holds, as each member consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. Bonded capital sits idle for 4 days. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
